title: The Pokédex search's orders: res/pokedex/orders.json
description: ARCID_POKEDEX_DATA's files 3 to 9 (a/0/9/7), the lists of the species in the orders that the Pokédex's search sorts by (sPokedexSearchOrderFiles in pokedex_search_engine.c), which tools/data/pokedex_data.py packs. An entry is a species, or [ species, form ] for a form other than the first.

national.description: File 3: the species by national number, which nothing reads (the search counts 1 to 649 itself)

regional.description: File 4: the search's order by number for the regional Pokédex (FILE_NATIONAL_ORDER of pokedex_search_engine.c), which it keeps the regional Pokédex's species of: the others in national order, then the regional Pokédex's in its order

alphabetical.description: File 5: the species by name, the search's order by name, which the Global Trade Station's and the Battle Video's searches also read

tallest.description: File 6: the species and forms by height, tallest first

shortest.description: File 7: the species and forms by height, shortest first

heaviest.description: File 8: the species and forms by weight, heaviest first

lightest.description: File 9: the species and forms by weight, lightest first

anyOf.description: [ species, form ]: a form other than the first
